thread.title_full: Senate Confirms Todd Blanche as Deputy Attorney General

author: ALANNA DURKIN RICHER
title: Senate Confirms Todd Blanche as Deputy Attorney General
text:
• The Republican-led Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as deputy attorney general on March 5, 2025.
• Blanche was previously President Donald Trump's criminal defense attorney.
• He was confirmed with a vote of 52-46.
• Blanche will serve under Attorney General Pam Bondi, a close ally of Trump.
• His confirmation comes amid turmoil in the Justice Department, including firings and resignations.
• During his confirmation hearing, Blanche stated that politics would not influence his decisions.
• He emphasized the need to restore public faith in the justice system.
• Blanche was a key figure in Trump's defense against multiple criminal cases.
• Special counsel Jack Smith has defended the cases against Trump regarding election interference and classified documents.
• These cases were withdrawn after Trump's November presidential win due to Justice Department policy.
• Emil Bove, acting as the Justice Department's second in command, will become the principal associate deputy attorney general.
• Bove has taken controversial actions, including demanding names of FBI agents involved in the January 6 investigation.
